title: Small-set Fourier weight lower bound
statement: For all sufficiently large integers $q$, the level-one Fourier weight of the small-set indicator exceeds $\frac{m_q^2}{4}\log(1/m_q)$, where $m_q=1/(q+2)$ is the prescribed Gaussian mass.
